meta.note: All numbers are produced by re-running the Python engine; no value in this file was typed in by hand. Re-running the same script with the same seed reproduces them exactly.
meta.priority_policy: Split + FCFS (the policy choice only matters when mixed orders are split)
meta.balk_rule: leave at arrival when in_system * p_bar / workers exceeds the threshold
meta.renege_rule: leave when service has not started within the threshold
meta.denominator_note: served/abandon statistics are restricted to arrivals after the 60-minute warm-up, matching mean_los; the engine's raw counters cover the whole run
